lede: The biggest item on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements goes before the dais — rules that directly shape how structures get built in a box canyon that knows what fire country means. Council also continues its work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program the same night, while the Housing Authority appoints members to its new Resident Advisory Committee and the Open Space Commission walks the ground on Valley Floor trail alignments.

notable.stake: First reading of wildfire resilience building-code changes affects every property owner.
